backendCode.model: const mongoose = require('mongoose'); const TestSchema = new mongoose.Schema({ name: String, email: String }); module.exports = mongoose.model('Test', TestSchema);
backendCode.controller: const Test = require('../models/Test'); exports.createEntry = async (req, res) => { const entry = await Test.create(req.body); res.status(201).json(entry); };
backendCode.route: const express = require('express'); const router = express.Router(); const ctrl = require('../controllers/testController'); router.post('/data', ctrl.createEntry); module.exports = router;

uiCode.component: import React from 'react'; import ReCAPTCHA from 'react-google-recaptcha'; export const Form = () => (<form><input type='text' /> <ReCAPTCHA sitekey='KEY' /> <button>Submit</button></form>);

testCases.unit: const request = require('supertest'); const app = require('../server'); test('POST /data', async () => { const res = await request(app).post('/api/data').send({name: 'Test'}); expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201); });

deployment.dockerfile: FROM node:18 AS build; WORKDIR /app; COPY . .; RUN npm install; CMD ["node", "server.js"]
deployment.cicd: name: CI; on: [push]; jobs: { build: { runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [{ uses: actions/checkout@v2 }, { run: 'npm install && npm test' }] } }
